title: Breaking Minecraft
description: Literally Breaking Minecraft with visual effects
body:
# Breaking Minecraft

A Fabric mod for Minecraft **26.2** that puts a pane of glass between you and the
game window. The more blocks you mine, the more shattered your view gets.

![Broken Minecraft image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/L0ZwfKwC/images/8d359872bf5431e114ac1ccee05e0bcef3f5e8a7_350.webp)
## How it works

- Every **2-4 blocks you break** (random) cracks the glass a little further
  (with a glass-break sound). The first crack is a single hairline.
- A fresh crack is **unstable** - it keeps creeping on its own for a moment
  before it settles, like real glass.
- Break it badly enough and there's too little glass left to hold together - the
  game **shatters for real and crashes**.
- Your crack level is **saved per world / server**.
- **Repair it** by **placing blocks** - every 2-4 blocks you place mends one line
  of crack. This runs entirely on the client, so it works the same on vanilla
  servers, modded servers and in singleplayer.

It is purely a client-side mod; the server (and other players) see nothing.
